implementation_scope: Opt-in train.attention_precision=bf16 for canonical plain Flex only; per-instance CausalSelfAttention precision, default FP32 and saved scoring/export FP32. Existing exact two-block GPT2 remains supported. No operator arithmetic/global projection precision changes.
supported_plain_Flex: Positive integer dimensions/depth; exact attention; learned positions; layernorm and tanh-GELU; pre-norm residual stream with final norm; untied head; FP32 projections and tiled attention. No custom expressions, RoPE/relative attention, SWA, QK norm, QKV convolution, state tokens, activation checkpointing or other objectives beyond LM/SFT.
parameter_fixture: FNV-1a uint32 over exact parameter name, bucket=((hash+17*flat_index) mod2^32) mod37-18. LayerNorm gains1+bucket/512; all other parameters bucket/64, exact F32. Independently reconstructed and required in parser.
independent_reference: NumPy-only full forward and explicit reverse graph: embeddings/positions, layernorm, FP32 projections, six-GEMM BF16 attention surrogate, GELU/MLP, residuals, final norm/head and cross entropy. No production implementation/IR interpreter import in model-gradient reference.
derivative_reference_control: Promoted the FP32 reference to binary64; central finite differences h = 1e-5 at three positions in every depth-one parameter tensor. This is not a finite difference of discontinuous BF16 rounding.
prospective_CUDA_profile_requirement: CUDA+DEVCHECK+profiler required; exactly six BF16 GEMMs per layer/head in BF16 cases, zero in FP32 controls. CPU binary must refuse require-cuda. No device outcome exists.

CLI_controls.default_omitted_vs_explicit_FP32: Bit-identical model/optimizer checkpoints and F32 GGUF; real LoadedLM and production factory checked via test-only embedding.

limits: No actual CUDA integration outcome, no CUDA CLI lifecycle, no quality/speed/adoption claim.
Only two tiny canonical configurations have full-array/model-gradient evidence; generic positive depth/width wiring is structurally uniform, not an exhaustive architecture audit.
BF16 backward is the declared quantized-GEMM surrogate, not the mathematical derivative of rounding.
CPU binaries compiled O0 correctness-only against source-verified pinned public CPU libraries; no performance measurement.
No paid resource or watchdog edit is part of this work.
